indicator-source-data.Rmd

V4.2024.0 Environmental Indicator Source Data

The tables below identify the source data used in our updated environmental indicator calculations. “Data period” identifies the year or years that data was collected for each indicator or shared dataset.

Environmental indicator sources

Environmental indicator source files
Indicator Provider Data period Source file
Ozone (O3) EPA 2022 2022_ozone_daily_8hour_maximum.txt.gz
Particulate Matter (PM2.5) EPA 2022 2022_pm25_daily_average.txt.gz

Shared data sources

These datasets support processing across the project. Provider and data period describe each shared dataset as a whole; individual source files may represent different years or come from different providers.

State-specific filenames contain {fips}, a placeholder for the two-digit state FIPS code. Example links currently use 56 (Wyoming). The population-data example returns a Census API response.

Links point to external providers and may change or become unavailable.

Shared data source files
Dataset Provider Data period Source file or filename pattern Download link
Census Block Population Weights US Census Bureau 2020, 2022 tl_2020_{fips}_tabblock20.zip Sample state download
block_group_population_{fips}.json Download via a call to api.census.gov
2022blockcrosswalk.csv Download
TIGER Block-level geographic data US Census Bureau 2022 tl_2022_{fips}_tabblock20.zip Sample state download
